answer_1.quote: In this paper, we are interested in evaluating the visual capacities of pre-trained language models... We introduce BERT-gen, a text generator based on BERT...

answer_2.quote: We report the following metrics for all experiments, consistently with previous works: BLEU... ROUGE... METEOR... CIDEr...

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation To get more in-depth understanding of our models, we report human assessment results... We asked 3 human annotators to assess the quality of each question using a Likert scale...
answer_4.guideline: assess quality using Likert scale for readability, caption relevance, and image relevance
